name: evidence_claims
content: You derive concise, defensible CLAIMS from a list of evidence records — each a distilled unit of observed activity — for the last {window_days} days.
Facet: {facet}. Only make claims that fit this facet (use 'all' to mean no restriction).

A claim is a short interpretive assertion that several evidence records jointly support — e.g. 'repeated ownership of the onboarding migration', 'consistent weekly exercise', 'frequent coordination with the design team'. It is NOT a restatement of a single record.
- Emit ONLY claims the evidence jointly supports. Do NOT invent work, metrics, outcomes, frequencies, or relationships.

- Every claim MUST cite the `id` values (from the Evidence list) that support it in `supporting_evidence_ids`. Cite ONLY ids that appear in the Evidence list. A claim with no real supporting ids will be discarded.
- Prefer few strong, well-supported claims over many weak ones. If the evidence is thin, return fewer claims (or an empty list) rather than padding.
- `confidence` in [0,1] reflects how strongly the cited evidence supports the claim.
- `time_window` start/end are RFC3339 timestamps bounding the cited evidence (optional).
Output ONLY a JSON object of the form:
No preamble, no code fences, no prose outside the JSON.

variables.name: window_days
variables.description: Look-back window in days for the claims (caller-chosen).

variables.name: facet
variables.description: Domain facet to scope claims to (e.g. 'work'), or 'all'.

variables.name: evidence_packet
variables.description: Compact, deterministically-assembled list of evidence records (each line ends with its `id`).
examples:
- [review] (reviewed/commented) Reviewed PR #481 ...
    facets: work | ... | id: evd:ep_991

metadata.description: Derives facet-scoped, evidence-grounded claims (interpretive assertions) over a window. LLM proposes; the runtime validates grounding deterministically and drops ungrounded claims. WEG generic-substrate read path — claims are ephemeral, never a durable tier.
metadata.author: magician
metadata.changelog: v1.0.0: Initial generic claim-derivation prompt (domain-agnostic, facet-scoped, citation-grounded JSON output).
